name: Choice Privileges Mastercard
balance_transfer_fee: $5 or 5% of each transfer, whichever is greater

verdict.text: Keep for frequent Choice Hotels stays; points don't transfer

earn_rates.category: Choice Hotels stays and Choice Privileges point purchases
Gas stations, grocery stores, home improvement stores, and phone plans

earn_note: The 3x everyday category list (gas, groceries, home improvement, phone plans) is unusually generous for a no-fee hotel co-brand card, on top of the 5x hotel rate. Bonus points don't apply to cash advances, balance transfers, fees, interest, or gambling transactions.

redemption_options.method: Free nights at Choice Hotels properties

points.note: Choice Privileges points are a hotel-only currency with no cash, gift card, or travel-portal redemption path; value depends entirely on which property's award chart you redeem against.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners. Choice Privileges is a standalone hotel loyalty program, not a transferable currency.

insurance.detail: Up to $800 per claim against damage or theft when you pay your monthly cell phone bill with this card, minus a $25 deductible, max 2 claims per 12 months
Not responsible for unauthorized transactions once reported

protection_note: Cell phone protection is the one real benefit here. No purchase protection, extended warranty, rental car coverage, or trip insurance are advertised; Mastercard World Elite's baseline security and concierge services still apply.
rental_note: No auto rental coverage is publicly documented for this card.

status_perks.name: Gold Elite status, Choice Privileges
status_perks.note: Automatic Gold Elite membership gives a 10% points bonus on qualifying stays and 10 Elite Qualifying Nights a year toward requalifying for Gold, without any stays required.

services.name: 60,000-point welcome bonus
services.detail: 60,000 bonus points after spending $1,000 in purchases within the first 3 months, worth up to 7 reward nights at select Choice Hotels properties.

services.name: No foreign transaction fee
services.detail: $0 on purchases made outside the US.

services.name: Milestone Rewards
services.detail: Bonus points or gift cards for hitting spending thresholds throughout the year.

services.name: Mastercard World Elite benefits
services.detail: Baseline concierge, travel, and security services included with the card's network tier.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns points on their spend (into your account)

additional_cards.note: No cost to add, and their spending earns the same category rates into your account.
